title: Bank of England MPC decision + minutes and vote split (12:00 London / 07:00 ET, no Monetary Policy Report)
source: EST: bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy/upcoming-mpc-dates, fetched direct 2026-09-09 — the 2026 announcement list reads verbatim '5 February · 19 March · 30 April · 18 June · 30 July · 17 September · 5 November · 17 December', and the Bank's own September-2026 minutes page is already live as 'to be published at 12pm'. Primary-sourced, but filed estimate per the event-research lane's no-self-confirm limit and because this calendar carries no confirmed source prefix for a non-Fed central bank — the same taxonomy gap ecb-decision-2026-09-10 and boj-decision-2026-09-18 were both filed under. The 12:00 London announcement time is secondary (press relay), the date is the Bank's own; checked 2026-09-09
notes: DISCOVERED IN THE fomc-2026-09-16 D-7 ADJACENCY SWEEP (2026-09-09), and it is the missing middle of a three-day central-bank stack this calendar was tracking only at both ends: FOMC 09-16 14:00 ET -> BoE 09-17 07:00 ET -> BoJ 09-18. The MPC MEETING ENDS 09-16, the same day as the FOMC statement, and the vote split publishes the following morning, so the first European session after a US decision that is priced ~50/50 opens onto a second policy print rather than onto clean digestion. This matters to the FOMC ledger for one reason only, and it is a supply/attribution reason, not a policy one: that ledger has logged for two consecutive rows that the US long end is making the highs (10Y 4.80%, 30Y 5.25% on 09-08, the 10Y its highest since October 2023) inside what the treasury-30y-bond-2026-09-10 sweep established was a SYNCHRONIZED GLOBAL long-end move (UK 30Y gilt highest since 1998, 10Y Bund 3.37%, 10Y JGB above 3%). A gilt reaction on 09-17 is therefore no longer automatically attributable to the FOMC's own spillover. Tiered medium on the same reasoning as the ECB entry and NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED: no house playbook is rates-keyed and no tracked symbol carries sterling-rates exposure. September carries no Monetary Policy Report (the next full forecast round is 11-05), so the payload is the vote split and the minutes, not a forecast. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action. Attribution on 09-17 is already crowded: eurostat-hicp-final-2026-09-17 06:00 ET, philly-fed-mfg-2026-09-17 and housing-starts-2026-09-17 08:30 ET, pending-home-sales-2026-09-17 10:00 ET, treasury-10y-tips-2026-09-17 13:00 ET, treasury-buyback-7y10y-2026-09-17 13:40 ET, treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-09-17, unsc-iran-panel-mandate-vote-2026-09-17, and the Fed blackout's own last day.
